posts.zh:
dsh-cache-miss 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。提示缓存未命中（cache miss）时，在重建缓存的 assistant 回复下方显示一条黄色缓存提示，展示未缓存（uncached）重新计费（re-billed）的输入 token、缓存命中 token 与首字延迟（TTFT）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-33eb15efa350976259bd.html
posts.en:
dsh-cache-miss is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Yellow one-line notice for a prompt cache miss after the cache was rebuilt; shows re-billed uncached input tokens, cached hit tokens, and TTFT.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-33eb15efa350976259bd.html
